# Words no file and no commit message in this repository may carry, one per line,
# matched case-insensitively as substrings. tools/no_trace_scan.py and
# .githooks/commit-msg read this list so that neither has to spell the words itself;
# CONTRIBUTING.md says why. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# This file is the one place the words appear and the scanners skip it.
# 'generated by' alone was here until Wednesday 14 October 2026 and matched 150
# innocent lines ('generated by tools/make_replay.py'): a repository full of
# generators cannot carry that word as a forbidden one. The attribution forms are
# narrowed below; the product names underneath still catch 'generated by <name>'.
generated by ai
generated by an ai
generated by a language model
generated with
co-authored-by
claude
anthropic
openai
chatgpt
copilot
gemini
ai-assisted
ai assisted
written by ai
